latest.title: Monotone invariant valuations on convex cones
latest.abstract: We classify the monotone $\SOn d$-invariant valuations, $d\ge2$, on the space of all closed convex cones. They are precisely the linear combinations of the conic intrinsic volumes with increasing coefficients, or equivalently, the nonnegative linear combinations of intrinsic volume tails, up to an additive constant. On nonzero pointed cones we obtain the corresponding characterization by Grassmann angles, settling a conjecture of McMullen. Every such valuation is automatically continuous in the spherical Hausdorff topology and is $\On d$-invariant. Our proof builds on the proof of the spherical Hadwiger theorem by Wang and Wu.
latest.workSummary: 分类闭凸锥上单调旋转不变赋值，得到递增系数的内蕴体积线性组合刻画。
latest.breakthrough: 在非零尖锥上解决 McMullen 所提刻画问题，并推出自动连续及反射不变性。
latest.limitations: 对象与单调不变性条件明确，不能推广为所有凸锥赋值的分类。 已补读相关引言或主结果片段，尚未逐行验证完整证明。
latest.aiEvidence: 用 OpenAI Codex 讨论数学论证并辅助写作修订。
latest.priorityReason: 凸几何基础分类结果，自动正则性机制具有工具价值。
